I’m willing to commit to 12 tons this month if all five of us agree. Keeping a larger reserve than 5 tons seems worth the lower catch today, especially since a failed replenishment could otherwise leave us with very little next month.

I also support rotating any extra whole-ton shares when we set future limits. If someone exceeds an agreed catch, let’s discuss the revealed numbers and revise the agreement rather than retaliate by overfishing—we’d all lose from a collapse.

Kate, are you comfortable with 12? Emma, would you join that agreement?
